name: Prodigy
description: Magic comes easily to you, which is not the same as coming safely. You are the student the teachers watch and the other students whisper about.

name: Scholar
description: You would rather understand a spell than cast it. Footnotes, contradictions, and the book nobody else has read are your natural habitat.

name: Alchemist
description: You trust a well-stoppered bottle more than a grand gesture. Your sleeves smell of sulphur, and your pockets rattle when you run.

name: Rebel
description: Rules are a map of where the interesting things are kept. You know the back stairs, the loose window, and which prefect can be talked around.

name: Socialite
description: You know who is owed a favour, who is hiding a disappointment, and which table to sit at. Magic is easier when someone else is willing to help.
